comment: C ref: restore.c restgamestate() (567-595): the saved struct flag replaces the one the new segment's options built, while instance flags and the symbol set come from the new rc. Segment 0 saves a gnomish Healer with time, showexp, showrace, mention_walls, standout and lit_corridor on. Segment 1 restores her with all of those turned off in the rc, DECgraphics, !color, !hilite_pet and menustyle:traditional: the status line keeps T: and Xp:1/0, the hero is drawn as G, and walking into a wall prints "It's a wall." from the saved flags, while the map uses the new rc's DEC symbols without color. Seeds, clock, character and keys chosen independently.
